verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The change correctly numbers evidence anchors by the count of accepted, rendered links rather than by their source-array positions. The executed-page coverage is non-vacuous: it distinguishes the old implementation with both an interior refusal and leading refusals, and it retains an all-accepted control that catches off-by-one or collapsed-label regressions. The rendered `+N more` expectations also exercise the shared `shown` count. Documentation matches the implemented behavior, and this display-only change does not weaken the existing URL refusal or introduce a trust-plane, workflow-permission, token, or injection path.
